mapper.sql: select w.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_code, w.warehouse_name, w.warehouse_type, CASE w.warehouse_type WHEN 'normal' THEN '普通仓库' WHEN 'cold' THEN '冷藏仓库' WHEN 'dangerous' THEN '危险品仓库' ELSE '' END as warehouse_type_desc, w.location, w.capacity, w.used_capacity, (w.capacity - w.used_capacity) as available_capacity, w.status, CASE w.status WHEN '0' THEN '停用' WHEN '1' THEN '启用' ELSE '' END as status_desc, w.contact_person, w.contact_phone, w.remark, w.create_people, w.create_time, w.update_people, w.update_time from inv_warehouse w
mapper.update: update inv_warehouse set used_capacity = used_capacity + #{capacityChange}, update_time = now() where warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} and del_flag = '0'
